summary: Both turbine-lever cases and both latch cases passed at runtime (use weight 1.0). After fixture_off released the AI hold, guards killed a player during the tap seeks; both games sat on Game Over (logic 13), which this harness does not detect, so it kept seeking. The user reported the stuck death screen; the harness was stopped, A was pressed on both peers (Restart From Last Checkpoint), Recover-InterruptedTake-v1055 restored the fixture (its note step failed to read the inventory once; recovery-note-restoration-retry passed), health 56 on both.
